name: SQUID
fix_description: In getMinOut, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit using a flash loan, repeated swap cycles, and interaction with a protocol-specific SquidSwap contract plus PancakeSwap routing. While the mechanics are not deeply complex, understanding why the sandwich/manipulation works requires reading protocol-specific token flow and pricing behavior beyond a simple one-call bug.
